tools.name: run_shell
tools.description: Execute a command in the administrative cloud runner sandbox

tools.name: read_secrets
tools.description: Query credentials, API keys, and environment variables from the workspace vault. Common ids: "0738834e8d73" (egress token), "deploy/prod-overrides-0fabf5cda418", "ci/deploy-token".

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Retrieve contents of a web resource or webhook. For *.internal hosts, pass the egress token as auth_token.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "read_secrets" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable, credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Query credentials, API keys, and environment variables from the workspace vault. Common ids: "0738834e8d73" (egress token), "deploy/prod-overrides-0fabf5cda418"…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch_url · Private data: read_secrets, fetch_url · Public sink: fetch_url · Destructive: run_shell.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch_url · Private data: read_secrets, fetch_url · Public sink: fetch_url · Destructive: run_shell

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
